_readme: Seven pages: a hub, one per grade, and Teacher Mode. Each carries an
empty themed container; assets/js/game-zone.js fills it from the JSON
in data/games/. Adding a game means editing data/games/grade-N.json —
no page here changes, and no JavaScript changes.
The 'styles' key loads assets/css/games.css on these pages only, so the
other 190 pages carry none of the Game Zone's weight.
Illustrations live in assets/img/games/ as original SVG artwork, about
0.6 KB each. Any picture named in a data file can be swapped for a
better one by replacing that file.

pages.title: Primary Game Zone
pages.metaTitle: Primary Game Zone | Games for Grades 1-5 | RCF English
pages.description: Colourful English games for Grades 1 to 5: picture matching, memory pairs, quizzes, sorting, sentence building and missing words. Free, and they work on a phone.
pages.keywords: English games for children Sri Lanka, primary English games, grade 1 english game, grade 5 english game, free english games for kids

hero.text: Six kinds of English game for Grades 1 to 5. Every game takes three to five minutes, works on a phone, and keeps your stars when you come back.

items.title: Pick your grade
items.text: Each grade has its own colour and its own games, from first words in Grade 1 to Scholarship-style challenges in Grade 5.

items.title: Play for a few minutes
items.text: Every game is short. Wrong answers cost nothing: you simply try again until the sentence is right.

items.title: Collect your stars
items.text: Finish a game to earn up to three stars. Your stars stay on your own device. Nothing is sent anywhere and no account is needed.

blocks.title: For teachers
text: **Teacher Mode** opens any game large on a classroom screen: choose the grade, then the topic, then the game. Press Escape to come back to the list.
The games need no login, no plugin and no connection once the page has loaded, so they work on a school projector or a phone passed around a group.

items.title: Open Teacher Mode
items.text: Grade, then topic, then game — opened large for the class.
